svg.data-input-ac: 100-240 VAC, 3 A max; 12 A fast-acting fuse in the PSU
svg.data-input-dc: -36 to -75 VDC, 8 A max; 20 A fast-acting fuse in the PSU
svg.data-fans: 3 hot-swappable modules, 2+1 redundant, exhaust; front-to-back airflow
svg.data-altitude: rated for operation up to 5000 m (HIG, Connecting Power)
svg.data-macsec: supported; the two cyan-banded SFP+ ports 26-27 are the MACsec pair
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1 default, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with an additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC, T-TSC, Class C accuracy
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out, BITS RJ48 in
svg.data-timing-caveat: NOS integration is necessary to activate the specific feature (datasheet footnote, and nine rows of the HIG LED tables repeat it)
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock; GPS/QZSS L1 C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, SBAS L1 C/A (WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS, GAGAN), Galileo E1B/C; passive or active antenna auto-detected, active supply 5 V DC / 150 mA, minimum RF sensitivity -166 dBm, 30 dB minimum signal strength
svg.data-cable-limits: ToD, BITS, 1PPS and 10MHz cables must not exceed 3 m (HIG section 12)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER, ZR (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-optics-sfp: 1G SFP SX, LX, EX, ZX (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-bmc-scope: individual BMC for automatic and remote platform health monitoring
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A

g.data-description: HIG GNSS row - Off (GNSS is not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not completed), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground). Every row but Solid Yellow is annotated "Need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (system timing synchronization disabled or in free-run mode), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source such as GNSS, 1PPS, PTP or BITS), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail). All but Solid Yellow annotated "need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG STAT row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (system boot complete under the NOS, annotated "need NOS to activate this feature"), Blinking Green (system is booting), Solid Yellow (system boot complete under the diagnostic OS)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (all FAN modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more FAN modules fail or no FAN module present)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PWR row - Off (no power or in shutdown mode), Solid Green (system power good, BMC present and BMC power good), Blinking Green (system power good, BMC present but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but BMC absent), Blinking Yellow (system power fail). Four meanings out of two colours and two behaviours
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-mgmt-l: HIG Management port LED table, left lamp - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt-r: HIG Management port LED table, right lamp - Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity)
g.title: mgmt

circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (PSU DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to this PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
